data.narrative:
UFORCE is a seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Oleg Rogynskyy (CEO) and Oleksiy Honcharuk (co-founder and board chair, former PM of Ukraine), having raised $50M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 17 same-sector, similar-valuation-tier companies, comprising 2 public comps and 8 private comps including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Stage-progression analysis was not applicable; the company's stated $1B+ valuation, if used as a base, would imply a $2.5B post-step-up valuation—more than 20x capital raised—suggesting data integrity issues with that reference point. Peer-median analysis proved viable. Across the 17-company Defense & Security comparables, the median valuation stands at $1.4B, with a range spanning $300M (floor) to $4.5B (ceiling). Named peers in the set include Chaos Industries at $4.5B (Series D), Skydio at $4.4B (Series F), Stark Defence at $4.0B (Series C), Dream Security at $3.0B (Series B), and Neros at $2.5B (Series C).

The triangulated valuation range is $1.2B to $1.6B, with a median of $1.4B. Key uncertainties include whether UFORCE's seed-stage position commands a discount relative to Series B–F peers in the comp set, and whether the Ukrainian founding team's policy connections meaningfully influence investor expectations relative to sector norms.
